terms.comment: Lewis & Short: Columella also writes armoracea. Traupman spells it amoracia and makes it a neuter plural.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 71.
